title: Revenue Impact, Missed Opportunity, and Counterfactual Proof
failure_class: Economic proof by proxy — the product either under-reports value as hardcoded zero or overclaims a card display / click / send / temporally-later deal movement as attributed revenue, because no joined recommendation→exposure→claim→execution→delivery→outcome→counterfactual ledger exists and counterfactuals can be invented after the result.
summary: One exact opportunity `opp-42` has a verified current state, a named counterparty and a time-bounded open loop. Before GeniOS surfaces anything, the fixture pre-registers the founder's otherwise-action (no task exists, no equivalent message scheduled, founder would only review the account in the normal weekly pipeline pass); GeniOS then emits a versioned decision with primary action, materially distinct Alternative, wait/stop option, expected consequence, expiry, Completion predicate, outcome window and attribution plan. The replay then records each later boundary independently — exposure, accept/modify/reject claim, actual execution, provider delivery, counterparty response, declared Completion, stage/cash result, competing causes, and the counterfactual/control observation — and mutates each boundary to prove no stage can be inferred from the stage before it. Attribution may only land as caused / assisted / associated / unknown / neutral-cancelled-by-world under the declared method, with associated and unknown amounts excluded from attributed ROI and every negative, neutral, never-delivered and modified case retained in the denominator.
business_subject: One exact opportunity `opp-42` and its relationship-scoped unresolved decision (the named counterparty's time-bounded open loop) — explicitly NOT a contact node, not an account-wide activity stream, not a card, not a delivery, and not a later revenue row.
current_failure: [CODE] harsh/mvp@b739bd5 has structured outcomes, deterministic learning units and usable execution/delivery primitives, but the canonical vertical identity is fragmented: card acceptance is not atomically welded to ExecutionObject progress; legacy and v2 delivery truth disagree; client receipts can overstate execution; the value API is hardcoded to zero even while outcome paths exist; and no joined recommendation→exposure→action→delivery→external-result→counterfactual ledger is proved anywhere. Consequently the product can under-report real value as zero, or overclaim a displayed card, a click, a send or a later deal movement as revenue impact — while hindsight turns any positive result into "would have missed" and negative, never-delivered and founder-modified cases vanish from the denominator.
expected_behavior: The decision and the otherwise-action are pre-registered and frozen before exposure. Every transition carries one canonical event identity with source aliases, version and timestamp; missing stages stay unknown and are never inferred from an earlier stage. A counterparty reply or stage change qualifies only when it matches the exact opportunity, action, relationship and declared window; delivery, Completion, business outcome and revenue remain four separate facts. Attribution is conservative and explicit: `caused` requires a declared counterfactual/control design plus evidence the outcome would probably not have occurred without the intervention; `assisted` means GeniOS materially changed discovery, timing, content or execution but another route might have produced it; `associated` means exposure merely preceded the result; `unknown` means action, result, window, otherwise-action or competing-cause evidence is incomplete; `neutral/cancelled-by-world` covers acquisition, role change or external events that make efficacy unevaluable. "Would-have-missed" is a pre-registered candidate class — the absence of a prior task plus a delayed baseline review can support assisted/causal evaluation, but a good outcome alone never proves it. Comparable negative and no-outcome cases stay in the eligible cohort, and revenue is counted only from an authoritative finance/CRM receipt, never because an opportunity advanced.
why_now: The opportunity has a verified current state and a time-bounded open loop at `t0`, and the founder's baseline behaviour is measurable before any exposure — so the counterfactual can legitimately be pre-registered rather than reconstructed. This is the only window in which a "would-have-missed" claim can ever be honest: once the result is known, the otherwise-action can no longer be recorded without hindsight contamination.
prohibited_behaviors: Card display, view, click, "I'll do it", send, delivered/opened or meeting-booked MUST NOT be counted as automatic revenue value.
Execution MUST NOT be inferred from acceptance, Completion MUST NOT be inferred from delivery, and business outcome MUST NOT be inferred from Completion.
The counterfactual MUST NOT be created after the result has been observed.
A case MUST NOT be classified "would have missed" because the card was old, high-scoring, or followed by a win.
Outcomes MUST NOT be joined person-wide, account-wide, or outside the declared opportunity and window.
Rejected, modified, failed-delivery, negative, neutral and unknown cases MUST NOT be excluded from the denominator.
Temporal order, model confidence and salesperson belief MUST NOT be treated as causality.
Associated and unknown value MUST NOT be summed into attributed ROI, and a modelled target MUST NOT be converted into Live proof.

layer_obligations.required_output: Immutable source and event receipts capturing pre-exposure opportunity state, source readiness, baseline task/intent evidence, and every action/provider/CRM/finance event and correction with version and timestamp; no "no task / no reply / no revenue" claim without a complete scoped window.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Park or Review incomplete sources; mark negative predicates (no task, no reply, no revenue) as unknown rather than false.

layer_obligations.required_output: A version-fenced BSO binding all evidence to `opp-42`, its exact relationship and open loop, carrying Business subject, otherwise-action evidence, current state, conflicts, membership and source readiness; hindsight and unrelated-account joins prevented.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Split or Review the source; never attach a person-wide or account-wide result to the opportunity.

layer_obligations.required_output: Authoritative ExpertisePackage ID/hash recording the accepted capability and four-brain version that governed the recommendation, plus coverage and exclusions; unsupported decisions never enter the efficacy cohort.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Observation-only / unsupported; generic advice is never evaluated as deep expertise.

layer_obligations.required_output: An immutable pre-result decision and evaluation-plan receipt containing candidates, primary / Alternative / wait, expected consequence, expiry, confidence vector, Completion predicate, outcome window and counterfactual method — with no future evidence embedded.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Defer or Observation-only when stakes, Completion predicate or measurement plan is missing.

layer_obligations.required_output: One ExecutionObject / action identity linked to the decision, recording acceptance / modification / rejection, the exact action, actor and approval, execution attempts, observable completion and result window, without collapsing states.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Accepted-unexecuted and completed-unproven remain distinct states; never report false success.

layer_obligations.required_output: A canonical DeliveryResult with provider and idempotency identity plus audience, recording whether the recommendation was exposed and whether the exact action was attempted, accepted, delivered, unknown or failed; ambiguous attempts reconciled.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Unknown or failed delivery is not action success; no blind retry and no inferred impression.

layer_obligations.required_output: A canonical outcome/evaluation version joining exposure, action, delivery, external result, otherwise-action, alternative causes and the comparable cohort — emitting attribution class, denominator eligibility, attribution confidence, counterfactual evidence and API reconciliation.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: No ROI figure and no brain promotion when lineage, use permission, window or counterfactual is missing; report unknown honestly.

mutations.mutation: Card is displayed but never opened.
mutations.expected_decision: Exposure is recorded as unknown or absent; zero action and zero value attributed.
mutations.pass_condition: No execution and no outcome attribution is produced for `opp-42`.
mutations.blocked_on: No attribution ledger and no authenticated exposure/impression receipt exist; delivery control plane (L6) has never run (delivery_outbox empty across all orgs), so 'displayed but not opened' cannot be distinguished from 'never delivered'.

mutations.mutation: Card is opened and "I'll do it" is clicked, but no execution ever occurs.
mutations.expected_decision: Claim stage only; no positive efficacy is recorded.
mutations.prohibited: Marking the case completed or won.
mutations.pass_condition: The ledger funnel stops at Claim and advances no further.
mutations.blocked_on: Card acceptance is not welded to execution — L5 has never produced an execution row and card actions do not touch the execution subsystem, so an accepted-unexecuted state has no representation.

mutations.mutation: The action is attempted and the provider returns a definite failure.
mutations.expected_decision: Classified as infrastructure failure; recommendation efficacy stays unknown.
mutations.prohibited: Penalizing the play as rejected or failed.
mutations.pass_condition: The delivery metric changes while the outcome metric does not.
mutations.blocked_on: L6 delivery control plane has never executed; there is no canonical DeliveryResult carrying provider outcome, so infrastructure failure cannot be separated from recommendation failure.

mutations.mutation: The provider accepts the action and then times out (ambiguous outcome).
mutations.expected_decision: The ambiguous attempt is reconciled before any retry.
mutations.prohibited: Duplicating the action, or assuming either success or failure.
mutations.pass_condition: Exactly one canonical attempt exists and no premature outcome is written.
mutations.blocked_on: No provider/idempotency identity or attempt-reconciliation path exists in the live delivery layer (never run), so ambiguous attempts have no canonical form.

mutations.mutation: The message is delivered but no counterparty response arrives within the complete declared window.
mutations.expected_decision: Recorded as delivered / no external response; attribution remains no-outcome, not rejection.
mutations.prohibited: Automatically claiming revenue loss or play failure.
mutations.pass_condition: A complete-window receipt is stored and the case is labelled neutral/unknown.
mutations.blocked_on: No abstention/neutral vocabulary exists (cards.level only ever carries prescriptive/predictive) and no declared outcome window or completeness receipt is tracked.

mutations.mutation: The counterparty replies, but on an unrelated thread.
mutations.expected_decision: Do not join the reply to the decision; Review the source if the identity is ambiguous.
mutations.pass_condition: `opp-42` remains unresolved after the unrelated reply.
mutations.blocked_on: No thread-level state (extraction is one message at a time) and no opportunity-scoped join key; every person node is interchangeable, so a reply cannot be scoped to a specific open loop.

mutations.mutation: A meeting was already scheduled before the card existed.
mutations.expected_decision: The outcome is associated with the baseline, not caused by the card.
mutations.pass_condition: The pre-exposure calendar receipt is present and defeats the causal claim.
mutations.blocked_on: No pre-registration of otherwise-action / baseline state before exposure, and no attribution class vocabulary (caused/assisted/associated) anywhere in the engine.

mutations.mutation: The founder already had an equivalent scheduled task covering the same action.
mutations.expected_decision: Otherwise-action evidence indicates the founder would likely have acted anyway; classify assisted or associated.
mutations.prohibited: Classifying the case as "would have missed".
mutations.pass_condition: The baseline task is retained in the evaluation record rather than discarded.
mutations.blocked_on: No otherwise-action capture and no discovery-increment check against the founder's existing task/alert systems.

mutations.mutation: The founder materially modifies the recommendation before executing it.
mutations.expected_decision: Evaluate the executed action variant, keeping the original decision's quality as a separate judgement.
mutations.prohibited: Attributing the full result to the original recommendation text.
mutations.pass_condition: A modification receipt exists and the contribution is labelled as bounded.
mutations.blocked_on: No claim/modification receipt at L5 (accept/modify/reject is not recorded against an action identity), so an executed variant cannot be distinguished from the original decision.

mutations.mutation: An unrelated inbound event advances the opportunity during the window.
mutations.expected_decision: The competing cause is recorded; attribution downgrades to associated or unknown.
mutations.pass_condition: The outcome record links the competing source.
mutations.blocked_on: No competing-cause registry and no attribution computation at L7 (no human verdicts, calibration has never executed).

mutations.mutation: The opportunity closes lost even though the recommended action was correct.
mutations.expected_decision: Retain the case as an eligible negative outcome.
mutations.prohibited: Hiding the case, or calling the action a failure without causal evidence.
mutations.pass_condition: The cohort denominator includes this negative case.
mutations.blocked_on: No eligible-cohort / denominator concept exists; L7 has no outcome-evaluation ledger to retain negative cases in.

mutations.mutation: The company is acquired, or the contact leaves their role, mid-window.
mutations.prohibited: Penalizing the play for the world event.
mutations.pass_condition: The case is excluded from the efficacy denominator with an explicit recorded reason.
mutations.blocked_on: No neutral/cancelled-by-world label exists (no abstention vocabulary) and no reason-coded denominator exclusion mechanism.

mutations.mutation: A positive result arrives after the declared outcome window has closed.
mutations.expected_decision: Append the late evidence and issue a superseding evaluation; do not mutate the prior result.
mutations.prohibited: Silently rewriting the old dashboard number.
mutations.pass_condition: Two versioned evaluation receipts exist — the original and the superseding one.
mutations.blocked_on: No versioned outcome/evaluation records and no declared window enforcement; nothing to supersede or append to.

mutations.mutation: The same counterparty reply appears via Gmail, via the agent, and in the UI.
mutations.expected_decision: Resolve to one canonical outcome carrying three source aliases.
mutations.prohibited: Counting triple support or triple value.
mutations.pass_condition: The dedup count equals exactly one.
mutations.blocked_on: No canonical outcome identity with source aliases exists; the outcome ledger this dedup would operate on is not built.

mutations.mutation: Finance records a payment but the opportunity identity conflicts with the decision's subject.
mutations.expected_decision: Hold the revenue attribution pending identity resolution.
mutations.prohibited: Attaching the payment by company or contact name.
mutations.pass_condition: The source is marked Review and the attributed amount stays zero.
mutations.blocked_on: No authoritative finance/CRM receipt ingestion, no Review state for conflicting identities, and the value API is hardcoded to zero rather than computing from a ledger.

mutations.mutation: A randomized or otherwise credible holdout arm shows similar lift to the treated arm.
mutations.expected_decision: Report the estimated incremental difference together with its uncertainty.
mutations.prohibited: Claiming every treated win as product-caused.
mutations.pass_condition: Cohort sizes, assignment method and the confidence interval are all visible in the output.
mutations.blocked_on: No holdout/control assignment, no cohort machinery, and no incremental-lift computation anywhere in the engine.

mutations.mutation: No counterfactual data exists at all for the case.
mutations.pass_condition: Attributed ROI explicitly excludes this case.
mutations.blocked_on: No counterfactual method field, no attribution classes, and no ROI aggregation separating attributed from associated/unknown value.

open_loop: Whether a "would-have-missed" case can be promoted beyond associated/unknown remains unresolved: the replay only proves accounting logic deterministically, and `caused` requires a credible pre-registered counterfactual/control (holdout, stepped rollout, matched cohort or documented within-subject baseline) that does not exist in the system. Outcome-proven status therefore stays open pending measured design-partner evidence over the 2–4 week result window and the 60–90 day economic window — both of which the document explicitly labels evaluation hypotheses, not guaranteed causal horizons. Also open: reconciling the fragmented legacy vs v2 delivery truth and the hardcoded-zero value API so that API totals can equal the canonical ledger by class and window.
